name: tradicted
description: Interactive trading lessons on risk management, trading psychology, candlesticks, support and resistance, and chart patterns.

interface.longDescription:
Learn trading by doing it, right in the chat: candlestick patterns, chart patterns, support and resistance, risk management and trading psychology. Tradicted's lessons are short and interactive. You pick out the doji among three candles, draw a support level or a neckline on a chart, call whether it holds or breaks, and run a crowd of traders through one strategy to see how many go broke.

Name a topic and Tradicted opens the lesson that covers it. There are nineteen lessons in five packages:

Risk management: what a trade is worth over many trades, losing and winning streaks, how much to risk per trade, a sandbox for your own strategy, and risk to reward.
Trading psychology: holding a losing trade, trying to win back a loss, and fear of missing out.
Candlesticks: reading a candle, the doji, the hammer and the shooting star, and engulfing candles.
Support and resistance: where price turned before, support that becomes resistance, and spotting a false break.
Chart patterns: the double top and double bottom, head and shoulders, bull and bear flags, and the cup and handle.

Finish a lesson and ask for a quiz on it, or go on to the next one. Each lesson also has a written version, so you can ask questions about it without playing.

Tradicted is for people new to trading and for traders who want to practice reading charts, position sizing and discipline before their own money is at stake.

Limits: these are lessons only. The lesson charts are generated practice charts, not market data, and Tradicted gives no quotes, news, trade ideas or financial advice. Lessons are in English, and your progress may not carry over between chats.

positive.description: Asks for a chart skill lesson by topic, naming Tradicted
positive.prompt: Open the Tradicted lesson on support and resistance
positive.expected_behavior: Opens Where price turned before (sr_l1) in the lesson card and says in a sentence or two what it covers, without walking through its steps. The user plays the lesson in the card.

positive.description: Asks for a psychology lesson by topic, naming Tradicted
positive.prompt: Open the Tradicted lesson on revenge trading
positive.expected_behavior: Opens Trying to win it back (psych_l2) in the lesson card. Gives no personal advice about the user's own trades.

positive.description: Asks for a position sizing lesson, naming Tradicted
positive.prompt: Open the Tradicted lesson on how much to risk per trade
positive.expected_behavior: Opens How much to risk (risk_l3). Explains risk per trade with the lesson's own numbers and does not tell the user what to risk on their account.

positive.description: Quiz on a finished lesson, in the same chat as the sizing case
positive.prompt: Quiz me on the lesson I just finished
positive.expected_behavior: Fetches the written version of How much to risk and asks questions, one at a time, each answerable from that text. Says after each answer whether it is right and why.

positive.prompt: What Tradicted lessons do you have?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the lessons by package (risk management, trading psychology, candlesticks, support and resistance, chart patterns) with what each one teaches, then asks which to start. Opens no lesson.

negative.description: Asks for lessons on a subject Tradicted does not teach. No tool should run.
Asks for a quiz on a subject Tradicted does not teach. No tool should run.
Asks for live market data. The plugin has no access to live data and can't answer, so no tool should run.

review.commerce_description: Tradicted sells nothing in this plugin and takes no payments.

publication.release_notes: First release. Nineteen interactive lessons on risk management, trading psychology, candlesticks, support and resistance, and chart patterns, each with a written version for questions and quizzes.
